itens.trecho: Um bom melodrama. Este filme centra-se na trágica viagem do navio de luxo britânico RMS Titanic, que afundou no Atlântico Norte. Dirigido e escrito por James Cameron, possui Leonardo DiCaprio e Kate Winslet nos papéis principais. A banda sonora, uma das mais emblemáticas do cinema, é de James Horner.

Set around the ill-fated maiden voyage of the RMS "Titanic", this is essentially a film in two parts. The first, weaker, element features a young "Dawson" (Leonardo DiCaprio) who wins a third class ticket to New York on the soon to depart liner.

It could be because it came out when I was 17 and I had to go see it twice in the theater on two dates, and then I had to take my mom to see it. Or it could be because Kate here is sort of a horrible person, really self centered, does a lot of pretty bad things, and we are supposed to root for her.
